_scaffold_note: First general-sweep map, route mode. Player = generic HP-bar anchor (no character). Mobs = models/mob_generic.pt. attack_range/aoe_max/gather numbers are starting guesses.
_player_note: HP-bar anchor shape for this map: your floating HP bar is ~7-8px tall (width varies with HP%, ~43-56 seen). The default accepted any red blob 2-16px tall, so near the map ends (camera clamped, you off-center) it grabbed STOP-sign mob parts, the red medal banner under your name (12px), bin signs and mob HP bars (4px), and damage numbers. Checked on the 646 captured frames. Remaining weak spot: big damage numbers covering your bar mid-attack.
_gather_note: z = push/gather (path-scoop) skill, 1s cooldown: dashes forward and scoops mobs along the path into a clump within attack_range, doubling as forward locomotion. grp/min/dash_gap are starting guesses: grp=how spread mobs must be to bother scooping, min=fewest mobs worth a scoop, dash_gap=attack_range - dash reach. Tune live.
_minimap_note: Minimap crop measured from a capture frame. The recording showed the same minimap x at the same place every lap (start ~43, portal ~214, jump ~195), so route until_x waypoints are stable despite the wide map.
_map_box_note: Valid minimap-dot box [x_min,x_max,y_min,y_max]. y_min 48 rejects the phantom reads seen in the recording (y 5-40 is not a platform level); levels are y~55 (upper), 62-84 (right platforms/slope), 99-109 (bottom).
_buff_note: Same buff groups as deep_sea_2 (d 5min, 3 10min, g 15min, 1 10min); each group fires on its own interval.
_route_note: Recorded from a human run (routes/flat_sweep.capture.jsonl, cycle t 0.7-81.6s) via build_sweep_route.py, then hand-tuned. Start the character at bottom-left (minimap x~43). Segments 2 and 5 take the SAME bottom portal (lands upper x~135): UP at x=219 (recorded 216/214/212, moved right). After the 1st portal she heads straight right (the recorded upper-left detour to 107 is dropped); after the 2nd she goes left to 45 and drops to the start. Segment 3 ends in 'edge_jump': the minimap dot PINS at x=195 while the minimap scrolls, so past it she fights and steps on until she walks off the upper platform (minimap y drops), then air-jumps.
_band_note: Only mobs whose feet are within this many screen px above/below her feet count (sweep decide is x-only). Levels here are ~600px apart, so 180 separates them. Without it she FIREd forever at upper-floor mobs in x-range. Override one side with band_up / band_down.
_rhythm_note: Route attack legs: one z push, wait push_settle_secs, then HOLD x for aoe_hold_secs (continuous AoE). x hold 1.05s = 2 casts (recording median 1.06s; 1.6s = 3 casts was tried). z->x gap recording median 0.61s includes human reaction; 0.3 used. Push cooldown 1.5s: a push decided while it is still cooling down walks forward instead until it is ready. No push within push_edge_margin minimap px of the segment end (edge/portal/jump spot) -- AoE only. No mob on her level -> walk.
_portal_note: Portal segments end at the minimap x where you pressed UP in the recording; before each UP press the loop lines her up with core.walk_to_x to within portal_tol px.
_mob_conf_note: 0.4 -> 0.6 (2026-09-24): she attacked air. Replaying the loop's decision on the 646 saved frames showed boxes on dropped loot (meso bags) and on AoE effects over dying mobs. On the labeled frames, 0.6 drops 36 -> 8 false boxes and keeps 96% of real mobs.
_debug_note: debug_log: per-beat decision trace -> logs/debug_<ts>.log + every attack's annotated frame -> logs/sweep_dbg/ (max debug_max_frames=400). Turn off once tuned.
_recovery_note: Each segment's y = its floor's minimap y (build_sweep_route.py). If she walks stuck_secs (4) with no progress -- e.g. a failed jump left her on the bottom, whose right end (~285) never reaches segment 5's 307 -- the loop resyncs to the next segment on the floor she is on (bottom-right -> segment 6, the portal leg). Minimap reads jumping > 40 px within 2 s are phantoms.
_jump_note: Edge jump (segment 3): no push after x=150 (push_margin 45 -- a push carried her ~27 minimap px into the pinned zone, landing at the edge); no facing tap before AoE in the zone (it stepped her off the lip mid-AoE); on the walk-off she jumps TWICE 0.3s apart (1st may still be a ground jump off the lip) holding right ~1s.
